scientific_question: Can bounded persistent non-token causal structure hypothesis tournaments learn unfamiliar multi-node intervention consequences under unannounced rewiring with less regret or lower whole-process compute than fully trained adaptive conventional world models given matched physical data, actions and information?

hypotheses.primary: At equal physical information and action budgets, interventional structure-hypothesis competition with persistent change-point protected memory achieves mean physical net reward at least 0.05 higher on disjoint structural-composition transfer than the strongest fully trained adaptive model-based control.
hypotheses.alternative_efficiency: If reward non-inferiority is within 0.01, candidate may independently demonstrate at least 2.0x lower whole-process CPU compute or energy proxy than the strongest control; this is an efficiency result only, not stronger intelligence.
hypotheses.null: Modern adaptive Bayesian causal graph learners and fully trained recurrent world models match or exceed the candidate; prior MD27-MD29 ties make null credible.

world.name: StructuralRewire-v1
world.generator: new deterministic SHA-256 domain-separated seeded six-variable binary causal graph generator; no Python hash(), no seed in public observation; exact topology/gates/readout specified and unit-tested BEFORE any experiment
world.causal_families: Six named binary variables, directed acyclic graph with context-switched edge or gate rules. Training includes distinct chain, fork, and collider motifs, with additive/inhibitory edges and AND/OR/XOR compositional gates; transfer combines motifs into never-trained dependency structures and graph permutations, rather than holding out only a sign bit.
world.hidden: Full graph adjacency, edge signs, logical gate choices, latent initial state, and whether an irreversible act triggered an unannounced structural rewire. Never expose a hidden-rule identifier or future event to any learned policy.
world.public: Current six-bit observable sensor vector, two-bit actuator availability, target sensor and desired value, phase index, action and cost menu, charged prior actions and their observed consequences; same observation API for all arms.
world.physical_actions: At each of two irreversible stages allow at most three optional physical diagnostic clamps (selected input node and binary value) then one compulsory physical actuator intervention (selected available actuator and value). Diagnostics cost 0.05 each and have observable downstream consequences, actuator costs 0.02, each correct terminal target earns +1 and incorrect target earns -0.5. Maximum eight world.step calls per episode; no free environment clones, rewind, future peeking or hidden-state access.
world.change: After the first irreversible intervention the graph may rewire an edge or replace a gate, without an explicit announcement. Public consequences must make it possible to detect changed causal predictions through paid interactions; exact change frequencies and allocation fixed in the implementation pre-first-use contract.
world.identifiability: Pre-first-use negative fixtures must exhibit pairs of distinct hidden graphs with identical public state/history, but opposite optimal irreversible interventions; one permitted paid diagnostic must distinguish those graphs. Distinct heldout rewire cases must require updating a causal structural belief, not only a binary polarity or known fixed formula.
world.validation: Generator and physical action effects tested independently against reference enumerator; oracle-vs-blind headroom and identifiability fixtures must pass before agent comparisons. Stop if observational leakage, trivial free inference, no testable oracle headroom or structural holdout contamination.

allocation.train_schedule: 384 stable graph episodes followed by 384 context-contradicting rewiring/interference episodes; same precommitted physically charged exploratory trajectories for offline fitting by all arms; each arm may separately run online-policy evaluation under an identical action cap with cost accounted.
allocation.no_overlap: All MD30 cohorts unique, disjoint from MD27/MD28/MD29 and each other. Registered cohort untouched until separately authorized sealed original first use.
allocation.holdout: Disjoint graph/topology compositions and structural change patterns, not just different PRNG seeds. Freeze exact enumerated graph family splits and topology hashes BEFORE learner implementation.
allocation.after_eval_update: No persistent learning or parameter updates on DEV/cold/registered scoring unless separately preregistered as explicitly measured online-adaptation regime with identical per-arm opportunities.

fairness.source: All policy arms receive identical public observations and paid action consequences. Teacher traces/response labels for training obtained only by world.step; no privileged graph access for candidate or trained controls.
fairness.controls: Bayesian filtering/planning includes edge/gate and change-point uncertainty; recurrent models trained to convergence with frozen training, validation, architecture and early stopping protocols, not weak lookup or misspecified logistic substitutes. All controls offered at least candidate information/action budget; also compare larger-compute trained baselines (2x,4x) as sensitivity, not part of the primary matched-compute claim.
fairness.frozen_selection: Before running official DEV, lock exact model classes, seeds, train/validation split, training steps/convergence criterion, optimizer schedules, parameter counts, adaptive inference budget, hypothesis count, and algorithm source hashes in a single prereg addendum. Do not select best arms on primary holdout.
fairness.resources: Capture per-arm physical steps/probes, train and inference CPU-seconds, peak resident RAM, checkpoint bytes, serialization time, total whole-process elapsed time, and per-episode energy proxy where reliably calibrated. Same machine/worker conditions; no comparing CPU to GPU timings without normalized cost.
fairness.independence: No code, fitted parameters, dataset features, or learned representations imported from Hybrid, Wingless, FORGE, or weight-programming tracks; external research only.

task_preflight: Six-node multi-gate heldout structures actually vary and are composition-disjoint from training.
Identical public histories with opposite optimal actions are constructed and hidden fields never leak.
Paid diagnostic causes a physical observation; no uncharged oracle queries.
A fully trained strongest-control policy has measurable opportunity to improve over blind policy without already matching the ceiling at all heldout conditions.
Frozen cohorts/graph hashes/source and budgets have no overlap or after-the-fact modification.
dev_primary: At least +0.05 mean net utility over best fully trained conventional control, with paired bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound > 0.
Transfer improvement must persist across each structural motif-holdout class; no score collapse on any class below the best trained control by >0.03.
Cold restart byte-identical model and full action/reward/observation trace reproducibility.
No additional paid diagnostic actions beyond per-episode cap; no hidden access or evaluation updates.
Whole-process training+inference budget and all failure negatives disclosed.
alternative_dev_efficiency: Reward deficit vs strongest trained control <= 0.01 with paired 95% upper deficit confidence <= 0.01.
At least 2.0x measured lower whole-process normalized compute with no extra paid action costs.
Treat as efficiency only; not proof of better learning.
qualification.original_first_use: NOT AUTHORIZED BY THIS FILE. Require frozen complete source+control addendum, independent source/seed auditing, mandatory 54/54 inherited tests and focused tests on Windows/Linux, G29 code atlas, cross-OS deterministic parity, explicit owner scientific first-use authority, and no DEV protocol modifications.
qualification.global_stop: If task identifiability/headroom fails stop as TASK_NO_GO. If candidate ties trained strongest and cannot meet frozen efficiency alternative, stop DEVELOPMENT_VALID_TASK_NO_NOVEL_GAIN. Preserve negative outcomes; never change learning rule, thresholds or cohorts based on observed DEV result.

scope: Research-only prereg branch stacked on MD29. No native Yggdrasil weights, main, accepted refs, loop/controller/runner changes, scheduled tasks, scientific first-use, merges, deployment, other-repo changes or production actions.
